businesses.business: rural Alaska electric and telecommunications utility

offering_description.value: Generates and distributes electric power and provides telephone, internet and cable services to remote Alaska communities. Sells electricity and communications service to households, businesses and public institutions, delivered over company-owned plants and networks.

primary_services.value: electric utility service; local and long-distance telephone; internet and cable TV; construction and operations services

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential households in remote Alaska communities; B2B: local businesses, fish processors, mines and resource companies; B2G: government agencies, schools and community facilities

end_markets.value: electric utilities; telecommunications; fisheries; mining; government

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: electricity sold by the kilowatt-hour to customers; service fees: monthly telephone, internet and cable subscriptions
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs hydro, diesel and other power plants and telecom networks, sells power and service to end customers; service provider: provides telephone, internet and cable services, takes in customer payments

geography_served.value: US regional: Rural communities across Alaska, mostly not connected to the road system

specialization.value: related lines: electric power generation and distribution, telephone, internet and cable services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: customers billed directly for power and communications service; own locations: company offices and service centers in local communities

regulatory_exposure.value: high: electric and telecom utility rates and service set by the Regulatory Commission of Alaska and FCC rules

notes: Specific service areas, plant mix and number of communities served are from general knowledge and may be incomplete.
